about: Read and watch time for every page, feed post, doc, research document, demo entry and webcam video on the Hire Me Hackathon site, so visitors can pick the best 5, 10 or 20 minutes. Read-only inventory; rebuild it rather than editing by hand.

method.words: Main content only: no menu, footer, red disclaimer, countdown, next-demo band, or screen-reader-only tables. Feed posts, the status board, docs, the privacy notice and the /d2 research documents are counted from their content files (feed.json, build.json, summary.json, content/docs/*.md, privacy.md, local/research/*.md, Markdown rendered with the site's own marked). Code-only pages (/, /for, /for/*, /d1 to /d11, /demos) are counted from the dev server's HTML (localhost:3100). Pages leave out the feed posts and research documents they embed, which have their own records, so nothing is counted twice.
method.read_min: words / 230, rounded up, minimum 1 (0 for a video with no text).
method.video_min: Embedded video length from its start offset, from the webcam lengths in ../OBS/Processed/S*/manifest.json, one decimal. A video record carries the full upload.
method.total_min: read_min for text; with video, words/230 + video minutes rounded to the nearest minute (never below read_min).
method.live: Production returns 200. Feed posts: the post's anchor is in the production home page's HTML. Research documents: the panel's anchor is in production /d2. Videos: YouTube oEmbed returns 200 (unlisted uploads).

totals.note: minutes_deduplicated = all words / 230 + every webcam video in full, once. sum_of_total_min double-counts the four videos (in their posts and as their own records) and rounds each item up.
